purpose: Fix a confirmed false positive in Q180 inference_processes: the prior substring scan classifies a bash command containing grep llama-server as an active inference server. Preserve positive identification of actual inference processes.
planned_change: Parse /proc argv and match the process comm/executable to known inference binaries; recognize known Python server modules only when the executable is Python. Do not match shell command text, grep/find commands, or arbitrary application prompts.
regression_cases: bash -c ... grep llama-server ... => not an inference server
unrelated electron/browser command => not an inference server
safety_invariant: This amendment narrows only false-positive shell-text matching; it does not bypass positive detections for actual llama-server PIDs. Dual-GPU preflight and runtime checks still abort on any foreign inference process or CUDA compute PID.
tests: CPU-only standard-library unittest; no model request, build, network, or GPU.
blocked_external_state: At preregistration time, PeritoSoft Qwen3.5-9B llama-servers PID 1870175 on 8033 and PID 1870341 on 8081 are active in a Claude-owned scope. Do not run Q180 inference until the foreign servers are absent.
